title: Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway damage: Toll collection suspended
description: The National Highways Authority of India has proposed declaring PNC Infratech a non-performer entity. Toll collection on the Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway has been suspended until repairs are completed. Action has also been initiated against sitting and former project directors for alleged negligence. An IIT Kharagpur team will investigate the cause of the road slippage. The concessionaire will bear the cost of rectifying the damaged stretch.

title: Morgan Freeman's quote on taking a leap of faith to chase your dreams
description: Morgan Freeman's career is defined by dignity and wisdom.  His quote emphasizes risking everything for unseen dreams.  Freeman aspired to be a fighter pilot in his youth.  He later pursued acting, debuting on Broadway in 1967.  His extensive filmography includes numerous acclaimed performances.

title: Meet Seungah Chung, who used 200 ants to reveal how they navigate
description: A bright young student embarked on a fascinating ant navigation experiment fueled by her natural curiosity. Through her meticulous research, she uncovered that ants primarily depend on visual markers for navigation. This groundbreaking project garnered her acclaim at a well-regarded science competition, showcasing the potential of such findings to inspire the development of innovative robots and autonomous systems.

title: Scientists link rising CO₂ to decline of the world's largest bees
description: Increasing atmospheric carbon dioxide levels pose a new threat to global pollinators.  Larger bee species are becoming less abundant and genetically diverse.  This shift favors smaller-bodied pollinators, impacting crucial pollination services.  Nutritional changes in plants make it harder for large bees to meet energy demands.  Protecting these vital pollinators requires addressing rising carbon dioxide emissions.

title: 'No need to apologise': Rahul meets student protesters, slams PM Modi, Shah
Sambhal violence 2024: Probe panel claims unrest 'pre-planned', links SP MP, MLA
description: Last year, three-member panel had met the CM and submitted its report concerning the violence that erupted near the Shahi Jama Masjid on November 24 in 2024 during an ASI-monitored survey of the mosque. The unrest resulted in four fatalities and injuries to several others. In the document, a sharp demographic shift is observed.

title: Trump's immigration crackdown hits US military families; over 50 spouses, parents detained
description: Dozens of parents and spouses of US service members face detention and deportation. This marks a significant shift from prior bipartisan immigration policies for military families. Many are detained during routine immigration status adjustment appointments. The Department of Homeland Security states military service does not exempt violations of immigration laws. These detentions negatively impact military readiness and family stability.

title: California to close westbound Zampa Bridge for 53 hours
description: Important notice for travelers: Westbound access on the Al Zampa Memorial Bridge will be entirely shut down for 53 hours, commencing on Friday, August 21, and concluding on Monday, August 24, to facilitate necessary repairs. Motorists are urged to anticipate heavy delays and to follow detour signs. Please be advised that foot and bicycle traffic will also be halted during this repair window. Prepare your travel plans accordingly.

title: Jharkhand recruitment protests: CM Hemant Soren says 'action soon'- top developments
Aamir Khan at Rawat funeral: Veteran ‘Ghajini’ actor dies at 74; colleagues pay tribute
description: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat was bid a final farewell in Mumbai, with Aamir Khan, Ashoke Pandit and other film personalities attending his last rites. Rawat, who died at 74 after battling blood cancer, was remembered for iconic roles in Ghajini, Lagaan and Mahabharat during his four-decade-long career.

title: Falcons could target veteran pass rushers after Jalon Walker's ACL scare
description: Atlanta's Jalon Walker faces a potential season-ending leg injury from training camp. This paves the way for seasoned edge rushers looking for a team. Joey Bosa, released by the Buffalo Bills, stands out as a prime candidate. Alongside him, Von Miller, formerly of the Washington Commanders, is also available. Each player presents a great opportunity to strengthen the Falcons.

title: Watch: Indian cargo ship engulfed in flames & smoke after projectile strike off Yemen
description: An Indian-flagged cargo vessel was struck by a projectile in Yemeni waters. The ship caught fire and sank off Yemen’s western coast near Hodeidah. All fourteen crew members, including thirteen Indians, were rescued by the Yemeni Coast Guard. The National Resistance Forces blamed Houthi rebels for the unprovoked attack. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the incident and called for unimpeded navigation.

title: BJP lost Bankipur, Datia bypolls deliberately to mislead on EVMs: Akhilesh
description: Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav has leveled accusations against the BJP, suggesting they deliberately lost the recent bypolls to distort public opinion on election integrity. He pointed out that the BJP’s departure from its typical campaign strategies was aimed at undermining opposition claims about EVMs. Yadav also promised that upcoming vacancies within the UP government would be filled by loyal party supporters.

title: Why US cities are deactivating Flock Safety cameras and canceling contracts
description: Cities across America are deactivating Flock's automated license plate reader cameras. Residents are damaging these devices amid widespread privacy concerns and data collection fears. Reports of law enforcement misuse have further fueled opposition to the surveillance technology. Flock maintains its cameras balance public safety and individual privacy rights. The company has implemented new audit processes to monitor technology usage.

title: After Pakistan boxer, Uganda athletes go ‘missing’ in Glasgow after CWG
description: Scottish police are probing reports of athletes from Pakistan and Uganda going missing after the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Four Ugandan boxers reportedly disappeared, with one seeking asylum, while Pakistani boxer Qudratullah was also reported missing. Pakistan finished with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra, marking its poorest Commonwealth Games campaign in decades.

title: Nearly half of India's workforce wants a new job. Here's why
description: Google leads India's most attractive employer brands, with Tata Group and Amazon following closely.  Nearly half of India's workforce plans job changes within the next six months.  Work-life balance and career progression are key factors influencing employee preferences.  Employers must adapt to evolving talent expectations beyond conventional benefits.  Organisations offering growth and flexibility will attract and retain top talent effectively.

title: Novig trolls Kenny Pickett after Panthers start him over Bryce Young
description: With Kenny Pickett stepping up as the Carolina Panthers’ new starting quarterback, he navigates the storm of social media criticism regarding his hand size. Just before the Hall of Fame game, he prepares to showcase his skills while previous starter Bryce Young watches on. A strong performance could solidify Pickett’s position as the team’s long-term solution at quarterback.

title: 'Why no system to remove defamatory posts?' Bombay HC on Gadkari deepfake case
description: The Bombay High Court ordered social media intermediaries to remove vile and abusive online content.  These posts falsely linked Union Minister Nitin Gadkari to the ethanol-blended petrol controversy.  The court granted urgent interim relief to the minister against several platforms.  Gadkari sought damages for fabricated and defamatory digital content, including deepfake videos.  The court also directed intermediaries to furnish basic customer information of content creators.

title: Watch: Video captures panic on Air India Phuket-Delhi flight
description: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi experienced severe turbulence on Tuesday.  Overhead bins were damaged and debris was scattered across the aisle.  Several passengers and crew members sustained injuries during the turbulent event.  The aircraft briefly lost altitude before landing safely in Delhi.  The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has initiated an investigation into the incident.

title: 'Grave security threat': CJP's Saurav Das alleges media 'breaking into' his house
description: The Cockroach Janta Party began as a satirical online response to a statement by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant but later developed into a broader youth-led campaign. The movement has focused on issues including exam security, administrative reforms and employment-related concerns. Das became one of CJP's most visible representatives due to his background in journalism and his ability to present arguments through data, documents and legal references.

title: SpaceX rocket piece 'crashes' into Moon: 4-tonne stage hurtles in at 8,700 kmph
'Consumers paying more': Congress alleges E20 is benefitting ethanol producers
'When Dhoni stepped away, Kohli-Shastri toughened Indian cricket': Rahane
description: Ajinkya Rahane believes Virat Kohli and Ravi Shastri toughened Indian cricket.  They instilled a fearless and aggressive approach, especially in overseas matches.  India achieved significant success under their leadership during this period.  Rahane expressed concern about the current Test cricket mentality and resilience.  He noted a decline in the patience required for difficult match phases.

title: 'Blast, blast' budget turned out 'waste, waste': Stalin's 'reel CM' swipe at Vijay
description: Tamil Nadu's opposition leader M.K. Stalin criticized the TVK government's budget as a waste. He stated the budget repackaged old schemes and lacked new vision. The finance minister presented a budget aiming for a $1.5 trillion economy by 2031. Opposition parties also pointed out unfulfilled election promises and debt concerns. The budget included allocations for schools, higher education, and welfare initiatives.

title: 'No trust in judiciary, EC': Dipke on political plans; calls for mass movement
description: Abhijeet Dipke, CJP founder, ruled out converting his organization into a political party. He stated public trust in democratic institutions has significantly eroded. Dipke emphasized the urgent need for a nationwide people's movement and public pressure. This movement aims to restore accountability and neutrality in key institutions. The CJP will continue functioning as a pressure group focusing on various national issues.

title: North Korea deploys missile unit, sends fresh ballistic arsenal to Russia: Ukraine
description: Ukraine has accused North Korea of providing Russia with new ballistic missiles along with personnel, involving around ninety North Koreans and multiple missile launchers. Reports indicate that a North Korean missile was used by Russia in a recent attack. This development signals a heightened level of military collaboration between Moscow and Pyongyang, following their treaty signed in June 2024.

title: Every fish tested in Yamuna carried microplastics. What it means for your dinner plate
description: Scientists discovered microplastics in every fish species sampled from the Yamuna River.  Fish from Delhi's stretch showed much higher contamination than those from upstream Haryana.  These plastic particles were found not only in digestive tracts but also in muscle tissues.  This contamination indicates a widespread issue within the river's aquatic food chain.  Addressing this requires reducing microplastic pollution from various sources.

title: Parliament deadlock: Rijiju meets Rahul to break logjam; Shah may speak on FCRA
Food for thought: Is Delhi's midday meal nutritious enough?
description: A dead lizard in a Delhi school lunch has renewed scrutiny of the midday meal program.  Concerns include hygiene, serving portions, and menu variety for students.  The PM Poshan scheme outlines nutritional entitlements for primary and upper primary students.  Budget limitations influence menu planning, affecting the inclusion of items like eggs.  Teachers and parents debate whether the promised nutrition reaches every child's plate.

title: J'khand student leader takes water after Wangchuk's appeal, to continue hunger strike
description: After four days without food or water, Jharkhand student leader Devendra Nath Mahto drank water following an appeal from climate activist Sonam Wangchuk but said his indefinite fast over alleged irregularities in state recruitment examinations would continue.

title: Watch: Valet drives car into parking lift shaft, plunges 2 floors
description: A car fell about twenty-five feet down a parking lift shaft. The incident occurred at the Horizon Gold building in Kandivli West. A valet attendant was steering the vehicle out of the building at the owner's request. The attendant was extricated by onlookers and taken to a local hospital. He sustained injuries after the unexpected fall into the shaft.

title: Kanwar Yatra in burqa: SDM court summons Tamanna Malik, husband
description: An SDM court issued notices to Tamanna Malik and her husband Aman Tyagi.  This action followed Malik's announcement to undertake the Kanwar Yatra while wearing a burqa.  Police cited apprehension of a potential breach of peace and law-and-order concerns.  The couple was bound down on personal bonds as a preventive measure.  They must appear before the court to provide an explanation for their decision.

title: In MP, A-certified ‘Dhurandhar’ screened at govt school
description: A video shows an adult film screened for students at a school.  The incident occurred on July thirty-first in Madhya Pradesh's Maihar district.  Villagers lodged a complaint seeking strict action against responsible individuals.  District education officer confirmed an investigation will be conducted soon.  Disciplinary action will follow the inquiry report's findings.

title: E20 row: ‘Contamination’ in fuel, says SIAM, later retracts
'Stalker abducted her once': Faridabad teacher lured to gate before her murder
description: A teacher was fatally stabbed by a man who had stalked her for two years.  He had previously abducted her and assaulted her husband, ignoring family assurances.  The victim had warned him of a police complaint if harassment continued.  The accused tricked her to the school gate using her husband's nickname.  Security lapses at the school allowed the masked assailant to enter the campus.

title: Delhi cop loses Rs 6 lakh in gaming, scripts ATM thefts to recover losses
description: After incurring heavy losses in online gaming, a Delhi Police constable turned to ATM theft as a solution. He gathered a team and taught them criminal tactics through internet videos. Their efforts led to the theft of more than twelve lakh rupees from two ATMs in Faridabad. However, the constable was left empty-handed when his gang refused to share the loot.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
description: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.
